Displays your full latest journal entry (Medium).
No schedules set yet. Tap + to add one.
No apps blocked yet. Tap + to block one.
To silence notifications, Focus needs Do Not Disturb access.\nWe\'ll take you to your phone settings — just tap Focus and enable it.
To block apps, Focus needs Usage Stats access.\nWe\'ll take you to your phone settings — just tap Focus and enable it.
To automatically silence phone notifications during scheduled hours, Focus needs access to your device\'s Notification Policy settings.
To detect when blocked apps are opened and intercept them, Focus needs Usage Stats Access to check which app is in the foreground.
“Stay focused. You set this boundary for a reason.”

To help you stay focused, Focus Guard will monitor which app is in the foreground and intercept distracting ones on your schedule. This requires Usage Stats and Overlay permissions. Your app usage data is processed entirely on your device and is never uploaded or shared.
To use the App Blocker, Focus needs your consent to monitor foreground apps on your schedule.
Configure block times and active days.
Lock distracting apps on your schedule
Focus Guard silences distractions and locks apps — on your schedule, automatically.
“The key is not to prioritize what\'s on your schedule, but to schedule your priorities.”
To show the block screen over distracting apps, Focus needs permission to display over other apps.
To block apps with an overlay, Focus needs Overlay access.\nWe\'ll take you to your phone settings — just tap Focus and enable \"Allow display over other apps\".
Earn rare badges by completing focus milestones, writing journals, or logging moods. Your highest tier unlocked badge dynamically highlights your profile avatar.
100% offline. Achievement progress calculated entirely inside local database (achievements table).
